literal_meaning: ছোট বাচ্চা এবং কাচ্চা (খেলাধুলা বা ছোটদের নির্দেশকারী শব্দ)
example_sentences_in_english: The fair was crowded with little kids.
The house is full of noise from the small children.
note: This idiom is a colloquial expression often used in informal Bengali speech to refer to young children in a light-hearted way, with variations reflecting regional dialects.
